root_cause.text: The replace_nexthop_single() function only calls nh_group_v4_update when replacing an IPv4 nexthop with an IPv6 nexthop, omitting the reverse direction (IPv6 to IPv4), which leaves the has_v4 flag stale in groups containing the replaced nexthop.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explains: "When an IPv6 nexthop is replaced with an IPv4 nexthop, the has_v4 flag of all groups containing this nexthop is not updated. This is because nh_group_v4_update is only called when replacing AF_INET to AF_INET6, but the reverse direction (AF_INET6 to AF_INET) is missed." The patch diff changes the condition from `oldi->family == AF_INET && newi->family == AF_INET6` to `oldi->family != newi->family`.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix missing group IPv4 indication update when replacing a nexthop with one of a different family, not just IPv4 to IPv6.
intent_record.what: Updated the condition from only checking when old family is AF_INET and new family is AF_INET6 to checking if old family is not equal to new family; also updated the comment to reflect the general case.
intent_record.how: The conditional block that updates the IPv4 indication within all groups using the replaced nexthop will now execute for any family change (e.g., IPv6 to IPv4) rather than only for IPv4 to IPv6 replacement.

grouping_result.intent: Fix missing group IPv4 indication update when replacing a nexthop with one of a different family, not just IPv4 to IPv6.

relevance_review.reason: The group directly addresses the vulnerability by fixing the omission of the group IPv4 indication update when replacing an IPv6 nexthop with an IPv4 nexthop, which is the missing case described in the root cause.
